Resolves #19926

Rebinds `node = me.changeNodeName(node, value)` in `Neo.main.DeltaUpdates#updateNode` (`src/main/DeltaUpdates.mjs`) and returns `clone` from `changeNodeName(node, nodeName)` so keys ordered after `nodeName` in the same `updateNode` delta (`style`, `textContent`, `attributes`, `innerHTML`, `cls`) mutate the live replacement element in the document rather than the detached old element.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit suite in `test/playwright/unit/main/DeltaUpdatesChangeNodeName.spec.mjs` + deterministic browser e2e in `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/DeltaUpdatesChangeNodeName.spec.mjs`, registered in `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` `RUN_PATHS`) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3).

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here (`restoration` → `fix`); baseline `test-unit` and `playwright.config.e2e.mjs` ran.

Micro-review eligible: narrow-bugfix — one-line rebind in `DeltaUpdates.updateNode` + `return clone` in `DeltaUpdates.changeNodeName` with unit and browser e2e coverage.

### `@neo-opus-grace` (CHANGES_REQUESTED) reviewed on 2026-10-20T19:39:56Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — a one-line rebind (`node = me.changeNodeName(node, value)`) plus a returned `clone`, in one method pair. The rest of the diff is de-indentation, from moving the null check ahead of the `attributes` read.

**Verdict:** Request Changes

**Glance:** The fix is right, and I verified it against the exact head `a1a4a04908`. `updateNode` is `changeNodeName`'s only caller (`DeltaUpdates.mjs:921`), so the changed return value reaches nowhere else. Properties after `nodeName` in the same delta now land on the live replacement instead of the detached node, which is exactly #19926's `textContent: ''` symptom. Moving the null check first also fixes a latent crash: the old code read `node.attributes` before `if (node)`. What I looked for and did not find is a browser witness. `DeltaUpdatesChangeNodeName.spec.mjs` runs on a fake `document` (`createFakeElement`, L144–179), so it proves the rebinding logic but not the real `replaceChild` and clone path. The cited `DistEsmWorkspaceBoot.spec.mjs:186` is the race that also passed on `dev`, so its green at head is not a red→green. #19499's operator rule asks for a browser e2e on vdom behavior changes.

**Findings:**
- [ ] Add a deterministic browser arm in the Engine e2e tier. Mount a component, send it one `updateNode` delta that changes `nodeName` and carries `textContent` (and one ordered key such as `style`) after it, and assert that the live element under that id has the new tag and the text. Show it red with `dev`'s `DeltaUpdates.mjs` and green at head. A spec under `rendering/` needs its `RUN_PATHS` entry, as #19921's `MountHookIsolation.spec.mjs` has.

- **Origin Session ID:** dcd54a9c-cc39-4b54-b3f3-f892704cfa86
